roadmap.title: Days 1-2: start a Hardcore run and gather dialogue points
roadmap.description: Turn on Hardcore, then take the count-based dialogue lines, Kim-opinion points and day-limited chances during the first two days.

roadmap.title: Day 3: the coast and side quests
roadmap.description: Once the coast opens, finish the pie, armour pieces, orb finds, pinball and Mullen outfit.

roadmap.title: Night 3 to Day 4: one vision quest and the medal
roadmap.description: Choose one political vision quest in the Night 3 dream and hand René's medal to the Pigs before he dies.

roadmap.title: The Tribunal
roadmap.description: Keep the Hardie Boys alive and decide whether Kim or Cuno is the partner who finishes the case.

roadmap.title: Finish the case
roadmap.description: Offer the figurines on the island, finish the case, and recruit Kim or Cuno. Finishing in Hardcore gives True Detective.

roadmap.title: After a Hardcore win: new game and Collage Mode
roadmap.description: Start a new Hardcore game for Kim's black jacket and finish the four Collage Mode photos.

achievements.summary: Pick seven plain, by-the-book police dialogue lines in conversations.

guide.context: Getting the thought @mechanic{Regular Law Official} adds more of these lines. Once the ledger is found and its marks are read, the Journal shows your running total.

steps.text: Choose the dull, professional answer, such as saying you are just a normal cop, whenever a conversation offers one.
Check your total in the Journal and repeat until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.summary: Pick seven dialogue lines in which you act like a deranged superstar.

guide.context: The thought @mechanic{Some Kind of Superstar} adds more of these lines.

steps.text: Pick the lines that call you a superstar or talk about fame, disco and parties.
Find the Damaged Ledger in the dumpster behind the @loc{Whirling-in-Rags} and read its watermarks at Kim's car; the Journal then shows your total. Keep going until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.displayName: The Opener Of The Eighth Seal
achievements.description: Warn them of the coming end 8 times
achievements.summary: Pick eight dialogue lines that warn people about the coming end of the world.

guide.context: The thought @mechanic{Cop of the Apocalypse} adds more of these lines.

steps.text: Pick the lines that talk about doom, the end, or the end of the world.
Find the Damaged Ledger in the dumpster behind the @loc{Whirling-in-Rags} and read its watermarks at Kim's car; the Journal then shows your total. Keep going until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.displayName: Literally The Sorriest Cop On Earth
achievements.summary: Pick ten dialogue lines in which you apologise or put yourself down.

guide.context: The thought @mechanic{Rigorous Self-Critique} adds more of these lines.

steps.text: Pick the lines that say sorry or run yourself down.
Find the Damaged Ledger in the dumpster behind the @loc{Whirling-in-Rags} and read its watermarks at Kim's car; the Journal then shows your total. Keep going until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.summary: Pick nine Communist dialogue options in conversations.

guide.context: The thought @mechanic{Mazovian Socio-Economics} adds more of these options. Four of them also lead to the Communist vision quest.

steps.text: Pick the options about the working class, the ruling class, workers' rights, or criticising capitalism.
Find the Damaged Ledger in the dumpster behind the @loc{Whirling-in-Rags} and read its watermarks at Kim's car; the Journal then shows your total. Keep going until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.summary: Pick ten Fascist dialogue options in conversations.

guide.context: The thought @mechanic{Revacholian Nationhood} adds more of these options. Four of them also lead to the Fascist vision quest.

steps.text: Pick the options about the monarchy, foreigners, Revachol being run by Revacholians, or women staying in the kitchen.
Find the Damaged Ledger in the dumpster behind the @loc{Whirling-in-Rags} and read its watermarks at Kim's car; the Journal then shows your total. Keep going until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.summary: Pick seven Moralist (centrist) dialogue options in conversations.

guide.context: The thought @mechanic{Kingdom of Conscience} adds more of these options. Four of them also lead to the Moralist vision quest.

steps.text: Pick the options about being reasonable, making slow steady progress, or calling other choices too extreme.
Find the Damaged Ledger in the dumpster behind the @loc{Whirling-in-Rags} and read its watermarks at Kim's car; the Journal then shows your total. Keep going until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.displayName: Baddest Hustler In The Neoliberal Hood
achievements.summary: Pick nine Ultraliberal dialogue options in conversations.

guide.context: The thought @mechanic{Indirect Modes of Taxation} adds more of these options. Four of them also lead to the Ultraliberal vision quest.

steps.text: Choose options on hustling, markets that run free, or money matters.
Find the Damaged Ledger in the dumpster behind the @loc{Whirling-in-Rags} and read its watermarks at Kim's car; the Journal then shows your total. Keep going until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.summary: Pick six dialogue lines that treat psychic or supernatural perception as real.

guide.context: The thought @mechanic{Remote Viewers Division} adds more of these lines once four of them are picked.

steps.text: Pick lines about psychic perception or believing in the supernatural. Good places: @npc{Annette} and @npc{Plaisance} about the bookstore curse, the central furnace in the @loc{Doomed Commercial Area}, and the @npc{Dicemaker}.

Behind the @loc{Whirling-in-Rags}, stand at the trash container with Kim beside you and Inland Empire at 4 or more. Say you sense something inside, call it extrasensory perception, then ask Kim what the Remote Viewers Division is.
Find the Damaged Ledger in the dumpster behind the @loc{Whirling-in-Rags} and read its watermarks at Kim's car; the Journal then shows your total. Keep going until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.summary: Pick four dialogue lines that show you know and love machines.

guide.context: Most of these lines need Interfacing 4 or higher. One Kineema line cannot be reached.

steps.text: At Kim's @item{Coupris Kineema}, ask whether all RCM police have such cool carriages, then say it is a sports model. When Kim asks about TipTop, answer with either option.
At the same car, run your fingers over a steering lever (Interfacing 5 or higher).
Raise the subject of @npc{Tommy Le Homme}'s machine with him, then agree that the lorries are neat.
Climb to the roof of @loc{Cuno's Shack} with Kim, use the cloak on the railing, choose Look Around, and point out the Kvalsund 10-20 HK crane.

achievements.summary: Pick five dialogue lines about art or judging art as an Art Cop.

guide.context: The thought @mechanic{Actual Art Degree} adds more of these lines. With Drama 5 or higher, praising @npc{Tommy Le Homme}'s style is a fifth line if you need one.

steps.text: Chat with @npc{Cindy} about her wall: praise public art, then describe the heavy fuel oil as clever cultural commentary.
In the Nightwatchman's Booth with Kim present, take René's photograph and say you are making a photo collage.
Bring up crime novels with @npc{Annette} and what a cop looks like, then pick apart the drawing on the cover.
Move the body into the Ice Bear Fridge, then tell Kim this was art, not police work.

achievements.displayName: The Most Honourable Cop in The Land
achievements.summary: Earn 11 honour points by picking honourable lines and deeds.

guide.context: Honour points come from the whole run: Lena's pin is Day 1 only, and René's medal option closes on Day 5. Pulling the boots counts as touching the hanged man, which conflicts with What body?. If you miss points, reload a save made before them.

steps.text: Day 1: meet @npc{Lena}, win the Suggestion check to receive her commemorative pin, then hand it straight back for two points.
Try to pull the boots off the hanged man and keep trying after Kim objects. Ask @npc{Call Me Mañana} for money and leave the dropped coin.
Offer to investigate for @npc{Plaisance} and pass the Drama check on the first try.
Day 2: promise @npc{Lena} you will find her husband and tell Kim you are honour-bound. Tell @npc{Garte} you would never reveal your sources.
Day 3 and later: refuse the washerwoman's free room once. By Day 4, refuse @npc{René}'s medal with Authority 4 or higher, or give the medal to the Pigs for the same point.

Take the honour option in the thought @mechanic{Kingdom of Conscience}. After the Tribunal, opt in to @mechanic{Overproductive Honour Glands} and tell @npc{Titus Hardie} that fighting beside him was an honour. Points the thought itself grants do not count.
Check the honour total in the Tasks menu once the ledger is read, and take other honour lines until it reaches 11.

achievements.summary: Physically attack five inanimate objects.

guide.context: Each kick or punch can cost a point of health.

steps.text: Kick the mailbox near the bookstore.
Kick the furnace in the @loc{Doomed Commercial Area}, reached through the back of the bookstore.
Kick down the roof door of the @loc{Whirling-in-Rags}.
On Day 1, do not ask Garte for the dumpster key. Take the prybar from Kim's car, use it on the dumpster behind the @loc{Whirling-in-Rags}, fail the Physical Instrument check, then kick the dumpster.
At the Boardwalk payphone, dial random numbers four times until an Interfacing check appears, then punch the phone twice.

achievements.summary: Tell seven different characters that you are the law.

guide.context: Most of these lines are available only at the first meeting, so use them then.

steps.text: When you first meet @npc{Tommy Le Homme}, @npc{Annette}, @npc{Cindy} and the @npc{Scab Leader}, say you are the law.
Tell the @npc{Working Class Woman} you are a policeman, shout it at the @npc{Sleeping Dockworker}, and say it to @npc{Idiot Doom Spiral}. That is seven different characters.
Find the Damaged Ledger in the dumpster behind the @loc{Whirling-in-Rags} and read its watermarks at Kim's car; the Journal then shows your total. Keep going until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Hit an all time low with Kim
achievements.summary: Reach -5 on your Good Cop / Bad Cop score with Kim.

guide.context: Only actions Kim witnesses count, so do these while he is with you.

steps.text: Find the Damaged Ledger in the dumpster behind the @loc{Whirling-in-Rags} and read its watermarks at Kim's car so the Journal shows your score.
Use the ledger to name the case, and turn down the title Kim offers.
Ask Kim about himself and call him a binoclard. Tell him your memory loss is a medical emergency that comes before the case.
Agree with the @npc{Racist Lorry Driver}, then fail the Rhetoric check when Kim confronts you for two more points.

achievements.description: Really get Kim to trust you
achievements.summary: Reach +10 on your Good Cop / Bad Cop score with Kim.

guide.context: Only actions Kim witnesses count, so do these while he is with you.

steps.text: Find the Damaged Ledger in the dumpster behind the @loc{Whirling-in-Rags} and read its watermarks at Kim's car so the Journal shows your score.
Ask Kim about himself, work through the case with him, and name the case in the ledger with your pencil.
At the hanged man, say he is dead and take every follow-up option for five points, then trace the serial number on Kim's radio.
Give @npc{Lena}'s pin back, tell Kim you would have taken the hubcaps as well, and skip anything he dislikes, such as begging or prejudiced lines.
Check the score in the Journal until it reaches +10.

achievements.summary: Get Kim to agree to join Station 41 after the case.

guide.context: This cannot be combined with recruiting Cuno in the same run. Make a save before the Tribunal so you can try the other recruit from there.

steps.text: Keep Kim's trust. A reputation with him above 0, and better above 7, helps the Authority check that saves him at the Tribunal.
At the Tribunal, when Harry is down, pass the Authority check to warn Kim about the approaching mercenary.
After the island, in the closing talk with Jean, Judit and Trant, invite Kim to Station 41. Do not pick the "Good luck with your report" line.

achievements.description: Get Cuno accepted as a junior RCM officer.
achievements.summary: Get Cuno accepted into the RCM as a junior officer.

guide.context: This cannot be combined with recruiting Kim in the same run. Make a save before the Tribunal so you can try the other recruit from there.

steps.text: At the Tribunal, do not warn Kim about the incoming shot, or fail the Authority check, so Kim is shot.
When you wake in the @loc{Whirling-in-Rags}, accept @npc{Cuno}'s offer to come with you and keep him for the rest of the case.
In the final scene with Jean, Judit and Trant, talk Jean into taking Cuno on as a junior RCM officer.

achievements.displayName: The Figurines Won't Win Her Back
achievements.summary: Offer the Headless FALN Rider figurine set to Dolores Dei in the dream on the island.

guide.context: Buy the figurine before you leave for the island. If you reach the island without it, reload an earlier save.

steps.text: In the pawnshop, check the Knick-Knacks Stand beside @npc{Roy}. An easy Interfacing check reveals the "Headless FALN Rider" figurine set, which costs 0.50 Real.
On the island, examine the bed in the flak tower to receive a nap task, then take the nap.
In the dream, offer the figurine to Dolores Dei and, if more offers appear, keep going until the conversation ends.

achievements.summary: Collect and wear all four obtainable Fairweather T-500 armour pieces.

guide.context: Taking the boots means touching the hanged man, so this conflicts with the achievement for never inspecting the body. To get both, use a save from before the body is touched, or a second run. The leggings cannot be found.

steps.text: When you ask @npc{Call Me Mañana} about the missing armour, choose the option to collect every piece so you get the task to find all armour pieces.
Greaves: once the hanged man is down, send Kim off for the night, come back to remove the boots, and boil them in the @loc{Whirling-in-Rags} kitchen.
Gauntlets: on Day 3 ask @npc{Cindy} about the armour, then ask the little girl in the fishing village. The gloves are buried in the sandcastle at the back of her house.
Cuirass: on Day 3 find @npc{Gary} with the cryptozoologists, pass the Composure check that shows he is hiding something, and press him until he hands it over.
Helmet: on the island, search the Insulindian Phasmid's nest after the Phasmid has left.
Equip all four pieces.

achievements.description: Eat the Deluxe Topping Pie that Gary delivers.
achievements.summary: Eat the Deluxe Topping Pie that Gary the Cryptofascist gives you.

guide.context: Gary leaves for good after the Tribunal and once the cryptid task line ends. If he is gone, reload a save from Day 3. You need Authority 6 and Endurance 6 for the first conversation.

steps.text: On Day 3 or later, talk to @npc{Gary} in the field with Morell, ask if he is also a cryptozoologist, then ask what he does instead.
Keep pushing until he says he delivers topping pies, and when Endurance chimes in, ask him to deliver you one.
After you finish inspecting the traps, find Gary back at the @loc{Whirling-in-Rags} and ask about the pie.
Eat the Deluxe Topping Pie.

achievements.summary: Begin a fresh playthrough with Hardcore mode enabled and finish any task.

guide.context: Keep Hardcore mode on for the whole run if you also want True Detective.

steps.text: In the main menu, open Options and turn on Hardcore mode, then start a new game.
Finish a first task, such as finding your other shoe, if the achievement has not yet unlocked.

achievements.description: Finish the game in HARDCORE mode
achievements.summary: Finish the game in a run played entirely in Hardcore mode.

guide.context: Do not turn Hardcore mode off during this run. Skill checks are harder than in normal mode.

steps.text: Begin a fresh run with Hardcore mode enabled and leave it enabled until the end.
Finish the case. You can pile up other achievements in the same run.

achievements.description: Be teleported back into the map after glitching out of bounds.
achievements.summary: Get Harry out of bounds with a glitch until the game teleports him back.

guide.context: This is a glitch and may need several tries. Save in a separate slot before you start.

steps.text: Go through the back of the bookstore into the @loc{Doomed Commercial Area}, then equip the flashlight so you can step into the dark section.
Stand against a wall in the dark room to the left of the stairs, aim at Kim, then unequip the flashlight.
Save, reload, and talk to Kim. Harry is teleported out of the dark. Repeat the save and reload if nothing happens.

achievements.description: Sleep in the trash container behind the Whirling-in-Rags.
achievements.summary: Spend a night in the dumpster out the back of the Whirling-in-Rags.

guide.context: Sleeping in the container ends the run, so save first and reload afterwards. It only works on Day 2 after 22:00.

steps.text: Make a save on Day 2, after 22:00, then talk to @npc{Garte} and argue that you deserve a free place to sleep.
End that conversation once, then return to the argument.
Accept the offer of a bed in the container out the back of the @loc{Whirling-in-Rags}.

achievements.description: Don't call it a book club.
achievements.summary: Complete the Communist vision quest, "Get yourself organised".

guide.context: Only one of the four vision quests can be done per run, and each starts in the dream on Night 3. Make a save before you go to bed on Night 3 so you can try the others. Do not call the group a book club.

steps.text: Before Night 3, pick four Communist dialogue options to get the thought @mechanic{Mazovian Socio-Economics}, and make a save.
Go to bed on Day 3 with the thought in your Thought Cabinet. In the dream, choose to pursue it, then accept the task from Rhetoric when you wake.
Talk to @npc{Cindy} about the reading club, then ask @npc{Call Me Mañana} about the ideologo to get the password.
Between 22:00 and 02:00, go to the gate at the @loc{Capeside Apartments} and say the password. Pass the Composure check to join the reading club.
Read the book they give you, talk to @npc{Steban} again, and save before the Rhetoric check. Pass it to ask your communist question.

achievements.description: You can still move your face with your fingers.
achievements.summary: Complete the Fascist political quest by finishing "Turn back the wheels of time".

guide.context: Only one of the four vision quests can be done per run, and each starts in the dream on Night 3. Make a save before you go to bed on Night 3 so you can try the others. Save before the mirror check and reload if the achievement does not unlock.

steps.text: Before Night 3, pick four Fascist dialogue options to get the thought @mechanic{Revacholian Nationhood}, and make a save.
Go to bed on Day 3 with the thought in your Thought Cabinet. In the dream, choose to keep going for Revachol, then accept the task from Endurance when you wake.
Talk to @npc{Measurehead} and pass the Suggestion check. Then talk to @npc{René Arnoux}, @npc{Gary} or the @npc{Racist Lorry Driver}.
Save, then use the mirror in your @loc{Whirling-in-Rags} room or the coastal shack and take the Endurance check.

achievements.summary: Complete the Ultraliberal political quest by finishing "Become a man of plenty".

guide.context: Only one of the four vision quests can be done per run, and each starts in the dream on Night 3. Make a save before you go to bed on Night 3 so you can try the others. The last step only works after the strike ends or after the Tribunal.

steps.text: Before Night 3, pick four Ultraliberal dialogue options to get the thought @mechanic{Indirect Modes of Taxation}, and make a save.
Go to bed on Day 3 with the thought in your Thought Cabinet. In the dream, choose to look out for your economic self-interest, then accept the task from Savoir Faire.
Talk to @npc{Cindy}, pass the Suggestion check, and buy her artwork for 10, 25 or 50 Real.
Open the harbour container by passing the Rhetoric check, offer the artwork to the container's occupant, the @npc{Mega Rich Light-Bending Guy}, and hire @npc{Idiot Doom Spiral} to handle your brand.
After the strike ends or the Tribunal is over, examine the finished @loc{Horseback Monument} statue.

achievements.description: Someone should do something about this.
achievements.summary: Complete the Moralist vision quest, "Take on la responsabilité".

guide.context: Only one of the four vision quests can be done per run, and each starts in the dream on Night 3. Make a save before you go to bed on Night 3 so you can try the others. Finishing this quest ends the run, so save before the last call.

steps.text: Before Night 3, pick four Moralist dialogue options to get the thought @mechanic{Kingdom of Conscience}, and make a save.
Go to bed on Day 3 with the thought in your Thought Cabinet. In the dream, choose to make steady progress, then accept the task from Empathy.
Ask Kim, then find the @npc{Sunday Friend} on the coast or speak to @npc{Trant Heidelstam}. Get help from @npc{Soona} or @npc{Noid} to contact the airship.
Pass the Conceptualization check, get a transceiver, and climb the @loc{Horseback Monument}. Gloves and the transceiver from Ruby's lorry help the Interfacing check.
Save, then talk to the airship contact and pass the Empathy check to address the Committee.

achievements.description: Solve the case without even inspecting the body.
achievements.summary: Finish the case having never touched the hanged man's corpse.

guide.context: Do not touch the body at all, even once, and avoid the boots that other achievements use. Make a save before you touch the body, such as at the start of the game, so you can reload if you click it by mistake.

steps.text: Leave the corpse out the back of the @loc{Whirling-in-Rags} completely alone, and never work on the task to inspect it.
In the final talk with Jean after the Tribunal, say you have quit drinking, then answer his smell comment with "Wait, what smell?!".

achievements.description: Here, just have one, they're free.
achievements.summary: Give René Arnoux's medal to the Pigs at the Boardwalk.

guide.context: René dies on Day 5, so get the medal from him by Day 4. Kim must not be with you when you meet the Pigs. Make a save before giving her the medal.

steps.text: By Day 4, talk to @npc{René Arnoux}, pass the Composure and Drama checks, and take the medal "The Setting Sun".
On Day 3 or later, send Kim away for the night and meet @npc{The Pigs} at the @loc{Boardwalk} alone.
Get your gun back, pick the "At ease, patrol officer Pigs" option, pass the Authority check (Authority 4 or higher), then choose the line that hangs the medal on her chest.

achievements.description: Pour one out for social democracy
achievements.summary: Keep Titus Hardie and Elizabeth Beaufort alive through the Tribunal, then invite Titus to join the RCM.

guide.context: Do not insult or antagonize Titus before the Tribunal. If a Tribunal check fails, reload a save made before the Tribunal.

steps.text: Be polite to @npc{Titus Hardie} when you question the people in the Union booth.
At the Tribunal, defend the Hardie Boys and pass the Logic check so @npc{Elizabeth Beaufort} is not shot.
Take out the mercenary Kortenaer with the Hand/Eye Coordination check so Titus survives.
After the Tribunal, speak to Titus. If you betrayed him, apologize and explain first. Then tell him the RCM could use a man like him.

achievements.summary: Throw dirt at the seagull on the coast until the birds by the Radio Tower shit on you.

guide.context: You need Hand/Eye Coordination 9 or higher to see the prompt. Kim must not be with you.

steps.text: From Day 3, go along the coast to Land's End on your own, without Kim.

Click the Hand/Eye Coordination orb, which shows when you stand a little to the right of the tree with the seagull west of the trap. Throw dirt and keep throwing, ignoring the warnings, until the birds shit on you.

achievements.description: *This* is the kind of animal you want to be
achievements.summary: Find the Leopard-Patterned Bodysuit near the Church and put it on.

guide.context: You need Electrochemistry 8 or higher to see the orb that points to the bodysuit.

steps.text: On Day 3 or later, go to the water south of the Church, near the Ravers' tent.
Click the Electrochemistry orb, pick up the Leopard-Patterned Bodysuit, and put it on.

achievements.description: Reconstruct a vision from the past
achievements.summary: Use the Visual Calculus orb at the Boardwalk to reconstruct the vision of the pleasure wheel.

guide.context: You need Visual Calculus 8 or higher. If it was lower when you finished the corpse task, raise it and go back outside the Working Class Woman's apartment.

steps.text: On Day 3 or later, finish the task about the dead body on the boardwalk, or report it to the station, with Visual Calculus at 8 or higher.
When the blue orb tells you to return to the @loc{Boardwalk}, go to the spot where the corpse lay and click the new orb.

achievements.summary: Wear Dick Mullen's hat together with the Pinball Maker's coat and activate Modus: Mullen through the Dick Mullen book.

guide.context: This easter egg only works on Days 3 to 5, with Kim away and before you enter Ruby's lair. Save and reload if either orb does not show.

steps.text: Get Dick Mullen's Hat from @npc{Annette}: work out why she bites her nails, get @npc{Plaisance} to let her inside, then talk to Annette again in the bookstore.
Take the Pinball Maker's Coat from the drawer in the old pinball workshop of the @loc{Whirling-in-Rags}.
Pass the Reaction Speed check to spot "Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity" in the bookstore and buy it. Read it through to the last page, then ask both Annette and Plaisance how the story ends.
Leave the bookstore and click the Logic orb (Logic 4 or higher) to make up an ending.
Put on the hat and the coat, click the Visual Calculus orb, and keep the thought.
Read the book again without Kim nearby and choose "Modus: Mullen".

achievements.summary: Knock on Kim's door at night until he answers.

steps.text: On Day 3 or later, after 21:00, send Kim away by saying goodnight in your room.
Leave your room, knock on the middle door at the @loc{Whirling-in-Rags}, and keep knocking until Kim answers. Finish the conversation.

achievements.description: Force Kim to reveal his secrets
achievements.summary: Win the eyebrow standoff with Kim when you ask him for a secret.

guide.context: You need Authority 8 or higher the first time you ask. Make a save before you ask.

steps.text: Reach Authority 8 or higher and save.
Ask Kim for a personal secret. He refuses, so ask a second time.
Choose to raise your eyebrow and keep going until Kim backs down.

achievements.summary: Pay to play the Gurdi's Goats pinball machine in the hidden workshop at the Whirling-in-Rags.

guide.context: The machine can only be played once. The final check is optional because the achievement unlocks either way.

steps.text: Pass the Perception check at the Union box window to get the key to the hidden blue door off the @loc{Whirling-in-Rags} kitchen.
Open the blue door, go down to the pinball workshop, and use the machine in the lower right corner.
Pay 1 Real to play.

achievements.summary: Finish the game in Hardcore mode, then start a new Hardcore game and see Kim wearing the black jacket.

guide.context: This needs a finished Hardcore run first. If the achievement does not unlock, save, close the game, and load the save.

steps.text: Finish the game with Hardcore mode on.
Begin another Hardcore run and head downstairs; Kim is wearing the black jacket.
Talk to Kim. If the achievement does not unlock, save, close the game fully, and load the save.

achievements.summary: In Collage Mode, find the four Cyanotype fragments, assemble them, and take a photo.

guide.context: Collage Mode has its own filter and location menus. If a fragment does not appear, zoom in or out and move the camera until its image becomes clear.

steps.text: Switch on the Cyanotype filter in Collage Mode and look in Steban's room at the @loc{Capeside Apartments} for the first fragment.
Find the other fragments in @loc{Roy's Pawnshop} and the Union office.
In the Underground Reading Room the last fragment is hidden; drag the view toward the top right corner to find it.
Open the Fragments tab, put all four together, and press the camera button.

achievements.description: Surely, it can be killed with fire
achievements.summary: In Collage Mode, find the four Daguerreotype fragments, assemble them, and take a photo.

guide.context: Collage Mode has its own filter and location menus. If a fragment does not appear, zoom in or out and move the camera until its image becomes clear.

steps.text: Switch on the Daguerreotype filter in Collage Mode and look at the boathouses by the Feld building in @loc{Martinaise West} for the first fragment.
The other fragments are in the hidden arms cache under the @loc{Doomed Commercial Area}, on the Dolorian Church's stained glass, and over the bed in Gary's flat.
Open the Fragments tab, put all four together, and press the camera button.

achievements.summary: In Collage Mode, find the four Ambrotype fragments, assemble them, and take a photo.

guide.context: Collage Mode has its own filter and location menus. If a fragment does not appear, zoom in or out and move the camera until its image becomes clear.

steps.text: Switch on the Ambrotype filter in Collage Mode and look beside Kim's car in @loc{Martinaise East} for the first fragment.
Find the other fragments in @loc{Cuno's Shack}, Evrart's office, and inside Lilienne's house.
Open the Fragments tab, put all four together, and press the camera button.

achievements.summary: In Collage Mode, find the four Chemigram fragments, assemble them, and take a photo.

guide.context: Collage Mode has its own filter and location menus. If a fragment does not appear, zoom in or out and move the camera until its image becomes clear.

steps.text: Switch on the Chemigram filter in Collage Mode and look in Harry's room upstairs in the @loc{Whirling-in-Rags} for the first fragment.
Find the other fragments in the harbour container, inside the @loc{Frittte}, and on the top floor of the bookstore in the Doomed F1.
Open the Fragments tab, put all four together, and press the camera button.
